description.value: Café Solo is a Ricky's-branded family restaurant in Burnaby serving all-day breakfast, lunch, and dinner as part of a Canadian chain that has operated since 1962. This location is a dual-branded facility (Ricky's and Famoso) with both a dining room and a patio. Touring cyclists will find a full sit-down meal option with takeout and delivery also available.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (2 spaces) at 63m; stands (2 spaces) at 72m; rack (10 spaces) at 77m. Total: 14 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this is the Café Solo location of Ricky's at 4415 Skyline Drive, Burnaby — address (including postal code V5C 5Y1) and phone (604-564-1393) both match OSM exactly. The location page explicitly lists 'Delivery Service,' 'Dining Room,' 'Online Ordering,' and 'Patio' as tagged amenities, confirming takeout and outdoor seating; OSM tags diet:vegetarian=yes which is plausible given the chain menu but not independently confirmed in the scraped text. No evidence of bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, or device charging appears in either OSM tags or website content.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records this node as 'Ricky's Grill' but the linked website page is titled 'Café Solo' — this is the operating name of the specific location. The OSM name does not match the actual location name shown on the website.
Location is described on the website as a 'Dual Branded Facility' (Ricky's and Famoso Pizzeria), which may affect how the listing should be presented.
No bike parking evidence found in OSM tags or website content, which is a required WWC criterion.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate full-service restaurant with patio and takeout that could serve touring cyclists, but none of the three required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) could be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify these before inclusion.
